name: Fuel dispatcher
design: Powerful adult female with dark teal-grey pebble skin, broad four-mandibled face, black dreadlocks grouped into two compact rear bundles. Heavy sleeveless ochre work tunic under cropped dark reinforced vest, wide crossbody safety belt, short dark skirt panels and tough leg wraps. Carries a sealed cylindrical pressure reader in left hand and a short capped coupling tool in right, no weapon. Practical robust silhouette.
